tasks.instructions: Directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.

passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 01
passage.text:
TEXT A - Community Center Notice

Dear residents,

Due to unforeseen circumstances, the swimming pool will be temporarily closed for maintenance from May 15th to May 22nd. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

During this period, members can use the facilities at our partner center, Riverside Sports Club, at no additional charge. Please bring your membership card for verification.

The gym, tennis courts, and yoga classes will remain open as usual.

Management Team

TEXT B - Work Email

From: Sarah Chen
To: Team
Subject: Project Update

Hi everyone,

I want to acknowledge all the hard work on this project. The client has requested some modifications to the design. I'm confident we can accommodate their requests. Let's meet tomorrow at 2 PM.

Best, Sarah

TEXT C - Product Advertisement

Tech Pro Smart Watch 5

Experience our innovative health monitoring system with remarkable accuracy! Features: Water-resistant, 7-day battery with rapid charging (30 min). Limited offer - 30% off!
